test_split: Exactly W4 IDs/splits/source crops; all human source_locator and task_tolerance fields omitted. Two old numeric locator hints removed, neither item removed. No resplit.
design_selection: Per model/category use dev AUROC for correct vs meaning_changed; minor excluded for AUROC. Raw safe score Q1=P(faithful),Q2=P(yes). Choose higher AUROC, exact ties or both undefined chooseQ2. Failed dev items unavailable; record, no replacement.
calibration: One per selected model/category monotonic regularized Platt fit on all valid dev rows: y=1 correct/minor,y=0 meaning_changed; x=logit(clamp(raw score,1e-6,1-1e-6)); sigmoid(a*x+b),a>=0. Minimize summed binary cross entropy+0.5*a^2 (L2 lambda1), b unpenalized. scipy L-BFGS-B starting a=1,b=logit(dev prevalence); no hyperparameter search.
single_class: If dev lacks either class, chooseQ2, mark calibration UNFITTABLE_SINGLE_CLASS, keep raw probabilities only for descriptive metrics; no verified gate (threshold=null). ECE after calibration is undefined, not identical fabricated fit.
threshold: On same valid dev calibrator outputs examine unique calibrated values inclusive>=t. Choose maximum verified count subject to empirical changed/count<=0.02; ties choose higher threshold. If no nonempty admissible set or unfit calibrator,threshold=null =>no verified. No smoothing, no test tuning.
ECE: 10 equal-width bins, predicted safe score vs y=1 correct/minor; report raw and calibrated separately on test.
AUROC: Test correct vs meaning_changed, minor excluded, raw safe score positive=correct. Also disclose source-class imbalance and calibrated AUROC ties if slope collapses.
risk: Test changed/all verified; coverage verified/all185 eligible test items by category including failed as uncovered. Undefined empty risk,null not0. Wilson95 descriptive only; does not certify<=2% production risk.
status: For evaluation only: runtimefailed=failed; calibrated>=frozen devthreshold=verified; otherwise raw safe<0.5=disputed, elseunverified. No canonical acceptance blocking.
comparison: W4 original published AUROC used P(changed); provide both published and harmonized AUROC from its saved P(faithful), no rerun of W4. Resolution/prompts/calibration differ, not causal model-only ablation.
hardware: Explicit MPS BF16, FP32 readout; no PyTorch CPU fallback. Nano may use CPU if initial MPS probe unsupported, preserving probe evidence; no mixed-device scoring within one model. Mini unsupported =>report not evaluated.8GiB host available hardfence.
timeout: 180s load/request parent watchdog; deadline13:43:16UTC leaves5min report within2h13:48:16UTC.
order: nano dev ->select/calibrate/freeze->nano test once; thenmini same; no26B. Flash not downloaded because all3fullweights30.2995GB>30GB cap.
